verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Bolna produces call recordings and offers Indian data residency and self-hosting. It never documents per-call recording on/off controls, consent or disclosure prompts, or configurable data-retention periods. Residency and self-hosting are adjacent controls, not the requested capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can meet call-recording consent and disclosure obligations with per-call recording controls and configurable data retention
